g.text: New P2 physical diagnostics: real paths and same-policy history intervention
Prespecified diagnostic cases 0 (accepted) and 4 (timeout); independent checks verified before plotting. Solid: full B3; dashed: 8D history masked.
120 Hz PhysX, continuous execution, no partial contact-state restoration. Equal success sets; no isolated velocity/rotation causation or method advantage.
The goal star alone is not the full task-success criterion. Full traces stay non-Git; exported states are decimated 4x.
